decisions.reason: The vertical mechanical-fit constraint does not change any battery-protection mode or cutoff requirement.
The source decision does not change the charge-status indicator, its GPIO, or the separate-LED constraint.
Requiring the board to fit vertically does not necessarily change the existing NTC connection on J_BAT.
The mechanical orientation decision leaves the battery NTC temperature-sensing method unchanged.
The vertical-fit constraint does not alter boost enable control, pull-down resistance, powered loads, or operating mode.
The source decision concerns board mounting and fit, not the required TVS-based ESD protection.
The source preserves a board-orientation constraint but does not change the USB-C connector functionality or sourceability requirements.
The power-board mechanical orientation does not change the I2C cable length, clock speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
